description: The studio's decisions layered over docs/research/evidence-register.json when scripts/registry/sync.py regenerates contracts/registry/components.v1.json. Every entry cites the ADR or document it comes from. Edit this file (or the evidence register), never components.v1.json. license_verification replaces named fields of a row from its pinned primary sources; open_rows names the gate and the label of a row that cannot close yet.

lane_rules.research_includes_individual: ADR-0011 rule 5: research is the private-experiments lane, so every component allowed in individual is also allowed in research.

swiftf0.source: ADR-0011 rule 6 and architecture.md §10: individual and research until its provenance review (MIT-labelled ONNX trained on CC BY-NC-SA data).

melband-roformer-kim.source: ADR-0006, ADR-0011 rule 6, the spec's Unverified capabilities table and the LLC-separator ticket: MIT code and weights, but its training data is UNVERIFIED, so llc waits for the training-data review; a passing review widens this row by contract-fix PR.

basic-pitch.source: ADR-0011 rule 6 (design review 2026-10-09): Apache-2.0, but trained partly on singing and piano datasets whose terms are unchecked (the register's own note cites iKala); individual and research until the provenance review ticket records its training datasets and their terms.

muq.source: O-06: non-commercial scorers are allowed in individual and research projects (diagnostics only, ADR-0005).

songeval.source: O-06: non-commercial scorers are allowed in individual and research projects (diagnostics only, ADR-0005).

cmi-rm-tunejury.source: O-06: non-commercial scorers are allowed in individual and research projects (diagnostics only, ADR-0005).

g2p-phonemizer.source: lanes.v1.json: individual and llc forbid an unverified license; widened when the lyric-error-rate ticket verifies the G2P.

midi-synth-soundfont.source: lanes.v1.json: individual and llc forbid an unverified license; widened by the MIDI synth evaluation ticket.

audio-decoder.source: lanes.v1.json: individual and llc forbid an unverified license; widened by the codec license ticket.

codegen-tools.source: lanes.v1.json: stack row, widened when T01 verifies the stack rows.

mp3-encoder.source: lanes.v1.json: individual and llc forbid an unverified license; widened when T102 codec-checks verifies an encoder.

lyric-aligner.source: lanes.v1.json: individual and llc forbid an unverified license; widened when T84 lyric-alignment verifies an aligner.

release_blockers.source: ADR-0011 rule 7 and RECONCILIATION.md §6 D-11 item 6, plus copyleft rows from §4. T03 (2026-11-07) verified mir_eval and mido, added the MP3 encoder and the lyric aligner as unverified rows, and classed waveform-playlist copyleft for its LGPL-3.0 waveform-data dependency.

obligations.source: RECONCILIATION.md §4 (output terms and redistribution columns). T03 rows from their pinned license texts (2026-11-07).

v1_path.source: architecture.md §3-§4, §7.3, §10; ADR-0002, ADR-0004, ADR-0005, ADR-0011 rule 6. T03: screens.md section 0.1 (fonts and icons), the accessibility audit, T56, T84, T102.

supplement.source: Components on the v1 path that the evidence register has no row for: the studio's own code and the stack libraries whose licenses RECONCILIATION.md §8 lists as never checked. Their licenses are recorded as UNVERIFIED, not assumed. T01 stack rows updated from pinned primary sources on 2026-10-29; source license verification does not imply installed artifact or transitive-license verification. T03 rows (interface fonts and icons, the accessibility audit, the YuE skill's abc_tools.py, the MP3 encoder and the lyric aligner) added on 2026-11-07 from pinned primary sources; open rows stay UNVERIFIED.

basic-pitch.verdict_condition: Provisional: a local hum benchmark (Basic Pitch vs SwiftF0.segment_notes vs pYIN+HMM, mir_eval COn/COnP/COnPOff) decides the A4 transcriber. LLC use waits on T54: three of its five training datasets carry non-commercial or academic-only terms.
basic-pitch.notes: Last release 0.4.0 (2024-08-16). Works best on one instrument; trained partly on iKala singing. No hum benchmark. Only humming figure: onset+pitch F1 0.434 octave-invariant / 0.268 octave-aware, no offsets (arXiv 2410.05455, course project, COMMUNITY). Main has unreleased 2025-11 fixes (#179). T03 license verification 2026-11-07: version 0.4.0 (tag v0.4.0, commit 9991303); LICENSE SHA-256 929c910bae2152fa87199a5d0660e09263419b7eee6d4b301d05ee2aaf211c37 (Apache-2.0) and NOTICE SHA-256 b810e55c0e3b520fabb45fc2ccc74880187bf84e309971968541cc812dcde905, which a redistribution carries; PyPI 0.4.0 declares no license. The bundled models sit under basic_pitch/saved_models/icassp_2022 (nmp.onnx git blob c30e5f9438e798604b7177aa26be1fe64482f767). Training datasets, the input to T54 (Table 1 of arXiv 2203.09893v2, PDF SHA-256 63040c77ce170c4c353f287ee5b777a57615098d799e998ec618a4f5de7d5b36, and the v0.4.0 data scripts): GuitarSet (CC BY 4.0), MAESTRO (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), Slakh2100 redux (CC BY 4.0), iKala (end-user agreement: academic purposes only, no profit; the official host no longer resolves, so the archived copy is cited) and the MedleyDB pitch-tracking subset (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial research only). Molina and Phenicx were test-only. The v0.4.0 data README calls its scripts a selection of the datasets used to train the original model. See docs/research/licenses/plumbing-sources-2026-11-07.json.
